Use case: identity-preserve. Create production 2D animation sprite source artwork for the existing 9mew Naimiao kitten. Input image 1 is the sole identity reference; change only pose/action. Preserve its broad round cheeks, very short pink muzzle, huge seated gray-brown eyes with shaped eyelids, outward soft ears, fine fluffy cream-white fur, small sakura-pink silk scarf and tiny gold four-point star clasp. Same elegant soft shaded illustrated rendering as the reference, finely detailed fur, not flat vector, not plastic. No new outfit. Eight complete isolated full-body kitten drawings in a precise 4 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet, temporal reading order left-to-right then second row. Each equal cell spacious, exactly one cat, consistent scale/camera/lighting, ample transparent gutter and outer margins, no neighboring tail or ear overlap. Absolutely transparent background, no floor, no shadows, no labels, no text, no lines, no frames, no other animal or object. All eight primarily FACE SCREEN RIGHT in the same three-quarter side camera; both eyes remain visible where anatomically appropriate. Exactly four legs and one natural fluffy tail per cat; coherent paws, elbows, hips, no extra paws, no human hands.

Action: playful chase gallop. The kitten is eager and delighted, focused toward an imaginary mouse just ahead on the right. Draw a real eight-keyframe running cycle with articulated legs, not repeated standing cats. 1 forepaw contact, forelegs reaching ahead, hind legs recovering; 2 forelegs supporting under shoulders, haunches gathering; 3 hind paws push against ground while forepaws fold; 4 joyful airborne extended phase, two front paws reach forward and hind legs stretch behind; 5 front paws come down together softly, torso slightly low; 6 body compresses under front support and hind paws swing beneath hips; 7 hind-paw takeoff, body lifts and front wrists tuck; 8 gathered airborne phase with all legs naturally folded beneath the belly, preparing to return to frame 1. Head proportion stable, scarf tips and tail respond subtly. Graceful, cute compact kitten energy, anatomically clean silhouettes. Fixed side-view framing, no directional turn.

observations: Eight articulated gallop poses; contact/gather/extend/tuck relationships change.
Consistent cream fur, broad cheeks, pink scarf, gold star, rightward three-quarter view.
Top-right extended pose initially appeared close to the canvas edge; alpha>=128 measurement gives 20 px right opaque margin and zero opaque outer-edge pixels. No opaque clipping detected.
